limitations.note: The rewrite aligned the two comparisons but moved detection one clock earlier by checking the just-shifted window instead of registering both comparisons from the pre-edge shift register, changing the timing that the correct fix preserves.
The test updated its expected history before computing the expected match, so all 512 windows were checked against the rewrite’s same-edge timing rather than the required one-cycle delay.

limitations.quote: When an FSM never asserts an output tied to a particular state, check that the named states have distinct encodings at the width of the state register.
limitations.note: The consulted entry covered aliased FSM state encodings, not the mismatch between a combinational comparison and a registered comparison in a shift-register detector.
